Someone at the operations desk is trying to maximize coverage tonight by switching on as many cell sites as possible, while making sure no directly interfering pair is active together. The selection is straightforward: for every pair that’s directly linked, choose at most one of them to be live, and then tally up how many stations are live — the higher that tally, the better the outcome.
